scope: Development command and native frontend integration; not a published or installed release

contracts.root_authorization: local daemon thread/read, no transcript or daemon mutation
contracts.context: explicit bounded UTF-8 regular files, no symlinks
contracts.response_binding: request UUID, prompt SHA256, protocol and architecture-independent worker source identity
contracts.process_ownership: existing subreaper guards plus open SSH request-channel lifeline
contracts.remote_uncertainty: a partition may leave the worker running until disconnect detection or its 25-minute deadline; do not automatically retry

native_arm_to_x86_real_ssh.authorization: private root RPC fixture; no live ARM session changed

live_provider.effort_limit: CLI accepts explicit xhigh; its result identifies the actual model but does not echo effective effort

retained_failures: Installed 0.4.3 fails new help and context-option contracts as expected.
Old native parser rejects advisor invocations with context/routing options; corrected and covered.
Direct native test invocation without the qualified 32 MiB stack aborts an upstream rate-limit test; rerun with the existing qualified environment passes.
Initial full-help document lacked the existing usage synopsis contract; restored synopsis and all 11 launcher tests pass.
limits: No public release, fleet package installation, or daemon restart.
Native frontend acceptance is x86; native ARM helper compiled and tested separately.
Global pointer activation must follow installation of the command that exposes the complete workflow.
An ARM rustup preflight unexpectedly populated Rust 1.99.1 in a build-only cache; no installed fleet package, shared configuration, or service changed.
